description: Opens .db, .sqlite and .sqlite3 files from chat links as tables, so you can check what an agent wrote without leaving the thread. Agents in the thread can list the tables of the open file and run read-only queries on it, so their answers come from the file. Draws an ER diagram from the foreign keys and runs an integrity check on open. SQLite runs as WebAssembly in the panel, and the file is never uploaded. Exporting the diagram, or more than 10,000 rows of a result, needs DBConvert PRO ($9 a month).
